content: रुह् €1 <ab>P.</ab> (रोहति, रुरोह, अरुक्षत्, रोक्ष्यति, रोढुम्, रूढ) .²1 To grow, spring up, shoot forth, germinate; रूढरागप्रवालः <ls>M. 4. 1</ls>; केसरैरर्धरूढैः <ls>Me. 21</ls>; छिन्नोऽपि रोहति तरुः <ls>Bh. 2. 87</ls>. .²2 To grow up, be developed, increase; रूढं क्षुधार्दिताः वत्साः … चरन्तु … तृणम् <ls>Bhāg. 10. 13. 6</ls>. .²3 To rise, mount upwards, ascend. .²4 To grow over, heal up (as a wound); रोहते सायकैर्विद्धं न सं रोहति वाक्क्षतम् <ls>Pt. 3. 111</ls>. .²5 To reach to, attain. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (रोपयति-ते, रोहयति-ते) .²1 To cause to grow, plant, put in the ground; तारयेद् वृक्षरोपी च तस्माद् वृक्षांश्च रोपयेत् <ls>Mb. 13. 58. 26</ls>. .²2 To raise up, elevate. .²3 To entrust, devolve upon, commit to the care of; गुणवत्सुतरोपितश्रियः <ls>R. 8. 11</ls>. .²4 To fix upon, direct towards, cast at; <ls>R. 9. 22</ls>. .²5 To fix, fasten. --{%<ab>Desid.</ab>%} (रुरुक्षति) To wish to grow <ab>&c.</ab>
रुह्, रुह {%a.%} (At the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) Growing or produced in; as महीरुह्, पङ्केरुह <ab>&c.</ab>
